scope: Primary reference for all future Chinese LMS episode SVG characters, stills and cutscenes. Only include characters present in the source scene.
supersedes: Previous Weed novel-cover and Hyun B references; preserve historical provenance and released packages.

characters.Hyun: Top center Weed / Lee Hyun. Tousled brown hair, amber eyes, ivory rolled-sleeve shirt, brown leather vest/harness, wrist guards, belts and pouches. Clever angular youthful adult face.
characters.Pale: Far left label Pale: honey-brown high ponytail, green eyes, green/ivory ranger outfit, leaf hair accent and bow. Follow this supplied depiction.
characters.Irene: Upper left, long honey-blonde hair, blue eyes, ivory and gold cleric robes and blue-jewel staff.
characters.Seoyoon: Upper left-center, long straight black hair, violet eyes, ivory and purple swordfighter outfit.
characters.Surka: Upper right-center, dark brown high ponytail, amber eyes, red and ivory martial-artist clothing, dark wrist wraps.
characters.Romuna: Upper right, long lavender hair, violet eyes, large purple witch hat, dark purple and gold mage dress.
characters.Mapan: Right of Romuna, round adult face, curly brown hair, joyful eyes, green and gold merchant robe, belt and pouches.
characters.Hwaryeong: Far right, long flowing black hair, warm brown eyes, red and gold dancer outfit and gold jewelry.
characters.Geomchi: Lower left, broad mature man, rugged face, long dark hair, dark beard, black/charcoal open martial robes and gold trim, sword.
characters.GeomchiDisciples: Five distinct young adult dark-haired men along lower row, black and charcoal martial robes with muted gold trim; preserve individual hair and face differences.

supporting_characters: Shopkeeper, Bard, Grandmother, Sister, Collector and Leader are not identified in this lineup; retain established designs until supplied otherwise.
svg_limits: Shared articulated SVG uses supported stylized clothing and hair shapes; approximate costumes with available tunic/robe/workshirt bases. Hat, bow, jewelry, harness detail and exact silhouette may require a future renderer extension; do not claim exact reproduction.
style: Detailed luminous fantasy anime/manhwa illustration, confident fine ink, rich warm cel shading and painterly depth. Preserve the supplied faces and costume identities, with scene-appropriate wardrobe when necessary.

Hyun.description: David approved Option A, the scrappy optimist: lean athletic Korean teen, near-black tousled hair, amber-brown eyes, lopsided grin and slate-teal rolled work shirt. Supersedes the lineup for Weed in the game SVG. Other characters retain the lineup direction.
